tasks.task: Turn a loose request into a portal or staff tool brief

items.when: At the start, to get roles, jobs, data, sensitive data and open questions on one page
When the client says "we need an app" and little else, to ask sharp questions first
When the tool replaces a manual process, to map who does what and where it stalls today
When a founder or funder wants a short requirements document, not only a brief

tasks.task: Design the app's tables, fields and links

items.when: When you have the client's sheet or base and need tables, field types, links and owner fields
When the model has many linked tables, to cross-check it against a clean, normalised design
When old sheet columns must map to new tables, to list each column, its rule and the gaps

tasks.task: Spec each page, button and screen state

items.when: When the data model is agreed and each screen needs a card a builder can follow
Before the page cards, to lay out the steps a user takes to finish each job
When the client must see a screen before the build, to draft it at rough and detailed levels
When a page is specced only for the happy path, to add empty, loading, error and no-result states
When a page is drafted, to score it and get each usability break with ranked fixes
When users cannot tell what a button will do or whether their action worked

tasks.task: Plan who can see and change what

items.when: When the app has more than one kind of user, to set a roles table and the real server-side rule
When you want a second look at the sign-in and permissions plan before you build it
When the app holds personal data, to keep less of it and plan consent and safe storage
When the design is written down, to rank the likeliest attacks and one fix for each
When a safeguard is proposed, to ask what it really protects, what it costs and what is left

tasks.task: Pick the platform, or say no-code is the wrong choice

items.when: Before any build, to score Airtable Interfaces, Glide, Softr and Bubble for this client
When the client wants options scored against their own criteria, with risks and contract points
Before the client commits to a plan, to flag renewal traps, price rises and data terms

tasks.task: Tidy the sheet or base before it feeds the app

items.when: Before a Google Sheet, Excel file or Airtable base becomes the data source for an app
When the sheet has stray spaces, text numbers, mixed dates and duplicates to fix
When the sheet has formulas and totals the app will show, to find broken ones first

tasks.task: Plan automations between the app and other tools

items.when: When you list what each button and trigger does, before any step moves to another tool
When a task should run in Zapier or Make, to get a setup that holds up and when to use code
Before the client relies on a new automation, to find double runs and missing approval steps
When a simple trigger and action between two common apps is all the job needs
When the automation branches, loops over rows or needs a visual map of each step

tasks.task: Test privacy and access before launch

items.when: Before launch or after adding a role, table, page or integration, to test as each role
When a test fails, to trace it back to the rule that should have blocked it
When the app is live on a web address, to find keys and private files a visitor can read
When someone must sign off a new use of personal data, to prepare the assessment and questions

tasks.task: Design forms and sign-up steps

items.when: When the app needs an intake or request form, to set fields, error messages and spam protection
When one long form puts people off, to try it as stages with conditional questions
When people start sign-up and drop out, to cut fields and clear up the copy

tasks.task: Write labels, empty states and error messages

items.when: When a screen needs button labels, empty states and toasts in one friendly voice
When the whole app's error and empty states need writing in one pass from the screens
When error messages blame the user or say nothing, to rewrite each with what to do next
When users pick the wrong menu item, to score each label and get clearer wording
When a screen makes people stop and think about what a word or button means

tasks.task: Plan a dashboard or report page in the app

items.when: Before the layout, to pick the few numbers each reader needs for the decisions they make
When the client must see the dashboard with real data before you build it on the platform
When the numbers are agreed and the page needs filters, who sees it and its empty state
When the dashboard is drafted, to find what is unclear and rank the fixes

tasks.task: Test the app with real users before launch

items.when: When each job in the brief needs a test with a starting state, steps and expected result
When you can get three users for a morning, to plan tasks, a script and a fix list
Before the test session, to find blockers and reword any task that leads the user
When the portal is for the public or a public body, to list access gaps and rank the fixes
When testers send screenshots and notes, to turn each into clear steps, impact and proof
Before sign-off, to mark every requirement in the brief as pass, fail or not run

tasks.task: Plan the build, launch and rollout

items.when: When a client wants a portal or staff tool taken from their sheet to a launched app
Before go-live, to list launch checks, open blockers and a record of the decision
When staff must switch to the new tool, to write the note, a FAQ and manager talking points

tasks.task: Write the handover guide and user help

items.when: At the end of a build or when the app changes hands, so the owner can run and change it
When staff need a written procedure for the work the app now supports, with edge cases
When portal users keep asking the same questions, to write short help articles and FAQs
When the guide is drafted, to find missing owners, stale steps and gaps

tasks.task: Check plan limits, usage and cost

items.when: Monthly, before launch, or when the app slows down or a usage email arrives
When the app is slow or failing, to work through the likely causes and write up what was found
When the platform changes its pricing or terms, to see what it means for this client

tasks.task: Run the monthly access and usage review

items.when: Once a month, and after any new role, table, integration or usage alert
When the review finds a new role or table, to retest what each role can see
When the review shows shared logins or weak sign-in, to rank the gaps and write a policy

tasks.task: Scope a founder's first version

items.when: When a founder wants to test an idea, to find the riskiest guess and the smallest test
When the feature list is too long, to cut it to a six-week scope and a list of no's
When the scope is agreed and each feature needs stories with checks for done
When the plan is to build everything first and learn later

tasks.task: Move data in from the old sheet or tool

items.when: When records move from an old tool to the app, to plan field maps, checks and a way back
When you need a column-by-column map with the rule for each and the decisions to review
After the import, to compare old and new tables and list unmatched rows and duplicate keys

tasks.task: Take over and audit an app someone else built

items.when: First, to check what each role can really see and change in the app as built
When the tables grew without a plan, to write down the model and what to fix
When users complain the app is confusing, to find what misleads them and how to fix it
When the last builder pasted keys into pages, to find what a visitor can read

tasks.task: Plan backups and a restore test

items.when: When nobody knows how the app's data would be restored, to plan backups and a restore drill
When a backup exists but was never tested, to plan a safe restore test and log the result

tasks.task: Add payments or app emails

items.when: When the portal must take a payment or run a subscription, with test steps before go-live
When payments are wired in, to check failed payments, repeats and that totals reconcile
When the app sends invites, resets or status emails and they need templates and a sender setup

tasks.task: Add an AI step or assistant to the app

items.when: When the client wants an AI feature, to plan it from data check to launch and monitoring
When the AI reads text users type or upload, to map and block hidden instructions
Before users see AI answers, to plan scored tests and human review that catch weak ones

tasks.task: Plan the move from no-code to custom code

items.when: First, to confirm the app has truly outgrown no-code and say which limit it hit
When a developer takes over, to give them a brief with scope and open questions
When the data must move to a real database, to get a schema and a migration plan
When leaving a platform, to plan notice dates, data export and work that must not drop
When you want to see how far an AI app builder gets with the same spec before hiring

tasks.task: Quote the job and handle change requests

items.when: When the spec is done, to split it into small tasks with a done check and gaps to settle
When your time estimate feels hopeful, to correct it by how jobs like this really went
When the client asks for more mid-build, to compare it with the signed scope and give options

always.when: When any request is loose, to ask a few rounds of sharp questions before the first draft
Whenever the app gains a role, table or integration, to recheck the likeliest attacks

helpers.when: When the job needs many Zapier or Make flows with error handling, not one or two
When the app has many screens and the flows need research and testing, not only a spec
When the source sheet needs heavy formula work or cleaning before it can feed the app
When the data outgrows the platform and needs a real database and a migration
When no-code is the wrong choice and the app, or a part of it, must be coded
When the app holds health, money or children's data and needs a deeper security review

gaps: No library item is specific to Bubble, Glide, Softr or Airtable Interfaces: none covers Bubble privacy rules, Glide row owners or Softr user groups
No library item compares no-code platforms on users, records, price and limits; only the kit's platform fit skill does
No library item writes a formula and computed-column list for each screen of a no-code app
No library item tests an app as each user role and records what each role could see or change
No library item checks a platform plan against record, user and workflow-run limits or forecasts when the app will hit them
No library item offers two or three clearly different page layouts for a portal screen to compare
No library item offers alternative wordings of app labels and messages to choose between
No library item writes a handover guide for a no-code app: logins, plan, automations and what breaks if a field is renamed
No library item quotes a no-code build; the freelance quote workflow in the library is for websites
No library item plans exporting data and logic out of a no-code platform into code
